speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you experienced any recent travel or exposure to tick bites?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any visual disturbances or upper right quadrant abdominal pain? Have you noticed any dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or did the headache resolve after the fever started? Given the ice cream consumption, have you experienced any abdominal pain or gastrointestinal symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are classic for Listeria monocytogenes. Given your pregnancy and the history of consuming ice cream, this points strongly to listeriosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
